title: A Weighted Spectral Quantum Fidelity
summary: We introduce and study a one-parameter family of fidelity-type quantities based on the weighted spectral geometric mean, which we call the \emph{weighted spectral fidelity} \( \mathsf{F}_t^{\mathrm{spec}}(ρ,σ):=\Tr\!\big[ρ(ρ^{-1}\sharpσ)^{2t}\big],\ t\in[0,1]. \) This family interpolates smoothly between the trivial overlap ($t=0,1$) and the Uhlmann (root) fidelity at $t=\tfrac12$, and it is distinct from the sandwiched Rényi family except at this midpoint. We establish core structural features-unitary invariance, tensor stabilization and multiplicativity, flip symmetry, endpoint behavior,…
